culprit_citations.quoted_text: Saturn Sound Bidco Limited First Lien Term Loan; par 57,365 appears under Par ($) / Shares (4)

rationale: FX01 assumes these debt principals are non-USD, but the raw filing schedule explicitly labels the principal column Par ($) / Shares (4). A representative debt row reports 57,365 in that dollar-denominated column. Therefore the non-USD premise is false and missing principal_amount_usd does not establish a required FX conversion; the check is firing from incorrect currency classification.
